data.one_liner: Flutter drawer widget that slides from any edge without requiring a Scaffold.
data.what_it_does: A navigation and panel widget that lets you slide drawers from all four edges of the screen. It supports backdrop blur, drag-to-close gestures, edge swiping, returning results, and displaying multiple drawers simultaneously without depending on a Scaffold.
use_when: You need drawers or panels that slide from the top or bottom, not just left and right.
Your layout does not use a Scaffold but you still need a slide-out drawer or overlay menu.
You want to return values (futures) from a drawer like a dialog.
avoid_when: You are fully satisfied with the standard Flutter Scaffold-bound Drawer.
You need standard Material Navigation Drawer behaviors built entirely around routing hierarchies.
strengths: Works without a Scaffold from any edge (left, right, top, bottom).
Supports multiple concurrent drawers, backdrop blur, and swipe-from-edge gestures.
Provides both imperative showDrawer and declarative AnyDrawer APIs.
weaknesses: Adds a custom overlay/route approach rather than integrating natively into the standard Scaffold Drawer architecture.
